thread:
kate: Heads-up — quickstart README has a copy/paste footgun. curl example uses Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY but Python/Node expect REDWOOD_API_KEY. New devs hit 401s.

kate: curl block currently:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

noah: Yikes. We should standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY. I'll open a tiny PR to replace the header and add an `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` note. Also fix quoting so it works on zsh/powershell.

li: There's also a Node snippet using default import `import Redwood from 'redwood'` which throws. We should show both ESM and CJS named-import examples.

noah: Draft PR at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/712 — changes: unify env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY, update curl to properly quoted single-line and multi-line forms, add Windows/PowerShell note, fix Node imports, add code fence language tags.

docs-bot: docs-lint: running checks on PR 712... snippet-scan: ensuring quickstart contains REDWOOD_API_KEY.

docs-bot: docs-lint: snippet-scan: PASS. Markdown lint: PASS.

deploy-bot: staging preview for PR 712 available at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-712

noah: Verified staging, curl single-line copy/pastes and Node ESM/CJS samples work locally.

li: Merged PR 712 and deployed to prod. Added a short changelog entry about parity fixes.

deploy-bot: docs-deploy: production deploy complete  https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart updated

kate: Confirmed prod shows REDWOOD_API_KEY and Node snippets fixed. I'll add a follow-up to onboarding emails to remind new signups to set the env var before copying examples. Closing this thread.
